items.question: Which drug is a 5-HT3 antagonist antiemetic?
items.explanation: Ondansetron blocks 5-HT3 receptors and is effective for chemotherapy and post-operative vomiting.

items.question: Which diuretic can cause gynaecomastia?
items.explanation: Spironolactone, an aldosterone antagonist, causes gynaecomastia and hyperkalemia due to antiandrogen action.

items.question: Caplacizumab used in TTP targets?
items.explanation: Caplacizumab is an anti-von Willebrand factor nanobody used in acquired thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

items.question: Mannitol is which type of diuretic?
items.explanation: Mannitol is an osmotic diuretic used to reduce raised intracranial and intraocular pressure. Avoid in pulmonary oedema.

items.question: Causality of an adverse drug reaction is commonly assessed by?
items.explanation: The Naranjo algorithm scores the probability that a drug caused an adverse reaction (definite, probable, possible, doubtful).

*PharmaCraft Daily - 20 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Gastrointestinal)
Q: Which drug is a 5-HT3 antagonist antiemetic?
Ans: Ondansetron
Why: Ondansetron blocks 5-HT3 receptors and is effective for chemotherapy and post-operative vomiting.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Renal)
Q: Which diuretic can cause gynaecomastia?
Ans: Spironolactone
Why: Spironolactone, an aldosterone antagonist, causes gynaecomastia and hyperkalemia due to antiandrogen action.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Blood)
Q: Caplacizumab used in TTP targets?
Ans: von Willebrand factor
Why: Caplacizumab is an anti-von Willebrand factor nanobody used in acquired thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

🌍 *FMGE* (Renal)
Q: Mannitol is which type of diuretic?
Ans: Osmotic
Why: Mannitol is an osmotic diuretic used to reduce raised intracranial and intraocular pressure. Avoid in pulmonary oedema.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Pharmacovigilance)
Q: Causality of an adverse drug reaction is commonly assessed by?
Ans: Naranjo scale
Why: The Naranjo algorithm scores the probability that a drug caused an adverse reaction (definite, probable, possible, doubtful).
